about:
DSI Manufacturing was founded in 1982 in Rogers, Minnesota. The company operates as a precision sheet metal fabrication and CNC machining firm, led by President Joe Hines. From its inception, DSI has focused on building long-term customer partnerships through a structured process it calls the DSI Proven Process.

The company runs two facilities totaling more than 80,000 square feet, housing equipment for sheet metal fabrication — laser cutting, stamping, forming, welding, and in-house powder coating — as well as CNC milling (3-, 4-, and 5-axis), CNC turning and Swiss machining, and surface grinding. A dedicated Rapid Response Cell accelerates prototypes and short-run jobs, while collaborative design-for-manufacturability services help refine parts before production. DSI handles both quick-turn prototypes and high-volume production runs across metal and plastic materials.

DSI serves industries including retail fixtures and displays, machinery and equipment, electronics and computing, communications, automotive and recreational vehicles, oil and energy, agriculture, and fluid handling and filtration. Its customer base ranges from global retailers to technology firms seeking precision metal and plastic components.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system, rapid turnaround via the Rapid Response Cell, and a collaborative mindset that integrates design, prototyping, and full assembly under one roof. DSI states its core focus is solving customer challenges by engineering and producing quick-turn lightweight metal products.
